sentence: This project studies how GABAergic neurons in the prefrontal area drive natural and drug reward seeking, using imaging and molecular approaches.
This project develops a blood test that adds to mammography for finding breast cancers early.
This project engineers fat cells to use more glucose and fat so they compete with tumor cells for these resources in mouse cancer models.
This project provides statistical and bioinformatics support to prostate cancer research projects, from study design through data analysis.
This project builds a learning method that finds 3D flow fields over time for each patient with vascular disease.
This project studies how obesity lowers the release of luteinizing hormone from the pituitary gland in sheep.
This project follows adolescents and young adults with dysmenorrhea for two years to find risk factors for later pain.
This project uses CRISPR to study how a herpesvirus stays latent in cells and leads to tumor growth.
This project studies whether synaptic density, the connections between brain cells, affects symptoms and daily functioning in people with schizophrenia, using brain scans.
This project uses a CRISPR screen in Drosophila to find host factors that help DNA viruses infect cells.
This project builds a universal influenza vaccine that combines several vaccine strategies to protect against pandemic influenza.
This project studies how a mutated gene that normally prevents cancer works with other cancer-causing genes to cause cancers of the blood.
This project studies how changes in astrocytes disrupt communication at synapses after traumatic brain injury, using imaging and genetic methods.
This project uses imaging of fixed cells and live cells to study how 3D chromatin interactions change over time and relate to schizophrenia.
This project tests whether tertiary lymphoid structures are needed for oncolytic adenovirus therapy to work against brain tumors.
This project tests whether artificial intelligence can spot people at high risk of heart attack and stroke from chest imaging.
This project uses mass spectrometry to measure proteins and lipids in mouse and human tissues and cells.
This project studies how marine food webs shape the nutrients and contaminants such as methylmercury that end up in seafood.
